subject: Supply Chain & Logistics
title: Supply Chains Shape History
description: A fast breakdown of Supply Chains Shape History for builders.

hook.text: Empires rose on trade routes and fell when supply lines broke. Logistics is history's hidden driver.

buildup.text: From Rome's grain supply to Britain's naval dominance, control of logistics shaped civilizations.

discovery.text: Wars were won by the side that fed and equipped its armies better—not just the one that fought harder.

twist.text: Today, economic power still follows logistics power. Countries with great ports and roads prosper.

climax.text: The story of logistics is the story of how the world became connected. And it's still being written.

punchline.text: Move goods, move history. Logistics shapes the world.

quiz.question: How have supply chains influenced history?
options: They shaped empires, wars, and economic power
